variants.name: 6 kg
variants.about_this_item:
Your small-breed puppy is growing fast, requiring a diet that is rich in protein and fat from fresh, whole animal ingredients to support proper development. Brimming with meat, organs, cartilage, and bone from chicken and wild-caught flounder, plus nourishing eggs delivered fresh or raw* to our kitchen by people we know and trust, ACANA™ Puppy Small Breed has everything your growing puppy needs for optimal growth and development.

1. 70%** QUALITY ANIMAL INGREDIENTS | PROTEIN-RICH & NUTRIENT-DENSE
2. 1/3 OF ANIMAL INGREDIENTS ARE FRESH OR RAW POULTRY AND FISH
3. 3 ANIMAL PROTEIN VARIETIES | FROM SUPPLIERS WE KNOW AND TRUST
4. WHOLEPREY | POULTRY, FISH, ORGANS, CARTILAGE AND BONE
5. FREEZE-DRY INFUSED | INTENSE NATURAL FLAVOUR
6. WHOLE VEGETABLES, FRUIT & BOTANICALS | FRESH
7. NO GRAIN INGREDIENTS***


*Our fresh ingredients use refrigeration as the sole method of preservation and our raw ingredients are frozen at the peak of freshness to preserve nutrients.
**Approximate and derived from the unprocessed state of the ingredients.
*** Produced in a facility that processes grains
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition

Fresh chicken (18%), chicken meal (18%), whole red lentils, whole green peas, fresh chicken giblets (liver, heart) (7%), chicken fat (7%), turkey meal (4%), eggs (4%), raw flounder (4%), herring meal (4%), fish oil (3%), whole green lentils, whole chickpeas, whole yellow peas, pea fiber, pea starch, raw turkey livers (1%), salt, dried kelp, fresh whole pumpkin, fresh whole butternut squash, fresh whole carrots, fresh whole apples, fresh whole pears, fresh whole zucchini, dried chicory root, fresh kale, fresh spinach, fresh turnip greens, fresh beet greens, fresh whole cranberries, fresh whole blueberries, fresh whole saskatoon berries, turmeric, milk thistle, burdock root, lavender, marshmallow root, rosehips

Analytical constituents

Crude protein 33% Fat content 20% Crude fibre 5% Crude ash 7% Moisture 12% Calcium 1.5% Phosphorus 1.1% Omega-3 fatty acids 1% Omega-6 fatty acids 2.7% EPA (eicosapentaenoic acid) 0.3%
